name: EPIC 248852556
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 9.2 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248852556 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.217148 (16th-84th percentiles 8.784282-9.603613), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248852556: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4617.0347 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

text.card: A red giant 4,312 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.05 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,617 K at its surface.
